name: highlighter
description: After each reply, Claude Haiku picks what to highlight: yellow for what needs your decision, blue for the key result, red for warnings, green for verified results. Color codes such as #0066CC are shown on their own color. The main model is never told. /highlight-preview shows what each color means.

model.title: Highlight model
model.description: The model that picks the highlights: a model id such as claude-haiku-5-5, or haiku for the model Claude Code currently calls Haiku.

theme.title: Highlight colors
theme.description: Which set of colors to draw: auto follows your theme, light or dark picks a set.

colorCodes.title: Color codes
colorCodes.description: Draw color codes such as #0066CC and rgb(0, 102, 204) on their own color.
